name: (Limited Time) Merry Rescue Mission

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: An old friend of mine, a client in the far north, got ripped off by some green grouch... Now, our friend needs some packages recovered from around the city... In one shot. Don't ask me how, but the packages ended up in four different nests in the QZ. Good luck!
debriefing: Happy holidays!

name: A Bigger Kindness

variants.desc: Find the supermarket near the hospital.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Well, Weiss didn’t like the last gift so much. Maybe instead, we get something more useful for her. You can see the bags under her eyes from a mile away, I’m a little worried. Anyway, since the market crash, fresh coffee has been really hard to come by. I’m hoping you can find a few cans of the stuff, might make her a little less miserable in there. There’s several stores to check- I’ll mark them.
debriefing: That’s a win! Dr. Weiss was very appreciative of the gift- she already seems in better spirits. Thank you, operator!

name: A Small Kindness

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Dr. Weiss has seemed especially exhausted lately. There’s days where she doesn’t leave the lab at all… Rumor has it she had a really strong lead on the cure, but it fell through, and that seemed to affect her badly. I think we should do something nice for her. There’s a luxury store near the shoreline that used to carry really nice expensive handbags… I’m sure you can find one there if you look. Grab it and bring it to me so I can give it to her… You’d be doing me a favor too.
debriefing: Well, she feigned appreciation but didn’t seem to care much for the handbag. Back to square one, I guess.

name: An Effective Shot

variants.desc: Photograph the downed crane construction site.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Hi, Bergher put me in touch with you. I'm Vanessa Munez, UNIDB correspondent with the Cooperative Publication. I was told you were involved in the raid on that construction site the other day- I'm looking to run a story about the recent action in the QZ. The Manhattan Star already put out some drivel accusing the UNIDB of foul play, but Bergher told me the UNIDB hadn't been contacted for comment. I'm looking to hear your story, but I also need someone in the field to take some photos of the construction site for the cover.
debriefing: Thank you, this is a great shot. Your story aligns with Bergher's telling- it sounds like the Manhattan Star is covering for the Sheepdogs.

name: Apocalyptic Appraisal

variants.desc: Reach Munez' old apartment building on Gouverneur and South street.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: This Federal Reserve event is serious business. Much of the media in the US is running with the Manhattan Star's story that the UNIDB committed the robbery. I think it's time to start looking into the connection between the Sheepdogs, Kismet, Insolon, and the Manhattan Star. I've decided that it's time for me to set up shop in the QZ. I had an apartment a few years ago in town, I think it could be a good place to use as a safehouse in the QZ. Head to the top floor of the apartments on Gouverneur and South street, make sure it's safe for me to come into town. I'll start packing.
debriefing: Thanks, sounds like it's time for me to head into the QZ.

name: Armored Patrol

variants.desc: Locate and destroy the abandoned Stryker APC.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: The first time the National Guard was deployed to help with disaster response, four Stryker mechanized infantry units were dispersed around this half of the QZ. I’ve had it confirmed that three of those four APCs are still right where they were left when the Guard was overwhelmed. We’ve yet to track down the fourth, but the other three need to be destroyed before they end up missing too. With our limited resources I’d love nothing more than to bring those things home here on the ship, but with the amount of gridlock I don’t see that being feasible without more risks than its worth. I’m having you scuttle them. The first one is near New Ground Zero, so it shouldn't be a hard demolition.
debriefing: Nice work. That’s one scratched off.

name: Armored Patrol, pt. 2

variants.desc: Locate and destroy the abandoned Stryker APC.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: We’re still looking into the whereabouts of the fourth Stryker. For now, take care of the second one. This one shouldn’t be too hard, it’s on the highway out near the shore, right next to an exfil site.

name: Armored Patrol, pt. 3

variants.desc: Locate and destroy the abandoned Stryker APCs.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Last one on the list; this one is right between the Hospital and one of the more recent evac zones, so you’ll want to be careful. There’s also an APC from the second evacuation wave… It’ll be desert-colored instead of green like the first-wave ones. Take that one out too while you’re there.
debriefing: Nice. That’s all the APCs in the QZ that we know the location of. I’m still having my guys look into where that fourth APC from the first wave went… I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

name: Asset Re-Appropriation

variants.desc: Find the parking garage of the apartment building in New Ground Zero.
Find the bank managers' white SUV.
Head to the Liberty Bank branch on Stone x Pearl.
Return to the UNS New York.
Find the parking garage of the apartment building in New Ground Zero.
Find the bank managers' white SUV.
Head to the Liberty Bank branch on Stone x Pearl.
Return to the UNS New York.
Find the parking garage of the apartment building in New Ground Zero.
Find the bank managers' white SUV.
Head to the Liberty Bank branch on Stone x Pearl.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: So I've got a bit of an idea if you're willing to try something a little risky. There's this bank on Stone, last I heard, the vault itself is hanging open, but the security gate in front is sealed. I did a little digging and found that the bank's long-time manager lived in the red apartment building in New Ground Zero. I'd bet that he was the one with the key to that security gate, and I'd bet that he was just starting his morning commute when the first attack happened. Keycard might be in or near his white SUV. If you can find it, then we've got a way into the vault. There's gotta be something good in there- I'll only take a third of the earnings.
debriefing: Ran into some trouble, huh? Worth it if you ask me. I’ll flip these bars into a real good payday for the both of us. Talk soon.

name: Connecting the Dots

variants.desc: Reach the office of the Manhattan Star
Eliminate the hostiles and reach the office.

briefing: I've set up pretty comfortably here in the safehouse you prepped for me, so thanks. My investigation is already proving fruitful-I’ve actually got a theory that tabloid magazine might have contacts within one of the hostile groups. Apparently, the Manhattan Star had an office in the city and I want you to search it top to bottom for anything that might clue us into their connection to the Sheepdogs, Insolon, or Kismet. Drop it off at the safehouse with me when you do.
debriefing: Well, looks like the connection found you instead. I'll be in touch, reading everything over now.

name: Defectors

variants.desc: Look for clues in Miller's apartment.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: I work within Beryllium 3... A little birdie told me you were looking for Sergeant Pierrat. Another defector, one of Mercury's lead researchers, Dr. K. Miller vanished, stealing vital data: our personnel roster and Ronograd operation records. The roster had the real names and familial information of many of our most trusted operators. We think he's planning to sell it to the terrorists we fought in Ronograd, who will use it to target the families of UNIDB staff. That might even include yours. We think Sergeant Pierrat is involved, and may have already met up with Dr. Miller, likely at his old home in Seaport. Check there and see if you can find any clues. If you find either of them, eliminate them immediately.
debriefing: You took out Miller? Good. Our enemies really are all around us… The guys guarding him were just local mercenaries, probably hired to protect him. I'll have my techs look at the cell phone you recovered. Keep in touch. - J. D.

name: Defectors, pt. 2

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: We scraped the cell phone, and sure enough, Sergeant Pierrat and Dr. Miller were in communication. We can also confirm that they were in communication with an unknown party in talks about a handover. Pierrat sent these contacts a location to come retrieve the information. Go there, stop them, and make sure that information doesn’t get out. Don’t forget the importance of the intel at stake, under no circumstances can it be leaked. Got it?
debriefing: You've eliminated a traitor who put all of us at risk, and recovered the vital information. You've served our organization more than I can say. Thank you. We're looking into the identities of those men who showed up to the deal. I'll get back to you if the investigation leads anywhere.

name: Enforcer

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: The QZ is dangerous enough, but various groups of bad actors make every mission all the more deadly. Some are more organized than others; we’re still gathering intel on who’s who. What we already know is there are plenty of small gangs of criminals hanging around; Many criminals chose to ignore the mandatory evacuation order, and instead remained in the QZ to live lives of pillaging and desperation. One of these small cells attacked one of my teams… I want to send a message. Head into the QZ and kill ten of the small-fry ‘bandit’ types.
debriefing: Good stuff, Operator. I hope those fools get the memo and keep their heads down for a while.

name: Eye for an Eye

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Your little raid on the Sheepdogs’ underground compound really got them mad. An organized assassination of several of our field agents showed us that they’re paying closer attention than we thought… And then they shot down one of our helos. The crew on board didn’t survive… but they were carrying a package Beryllium considers high-priority. We’ve got an agent posted up to watch the crash site, and so far the Sheepdogs have only sent a couple scouts who got run off by the nearby nest. Our guy has got to bail soon so you need to get in and get the intel ASAP.
debriefing: Looks like they were waiting for you. Should’ve guessed but we really couldn’t risk losing the intel. Til next time.

name: Eyes Everywhere

variants.desc: Find the hard drive hidden in the listening post.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: So, the Kismet guys flinched. Scouts reported the remaining patrols all retreating to a building right in the middle of town, near Ground Zero. We've identified the top floors of that building as the company's American headquarters. While we plan our next move, there is a small Kismet detachment moving towards the pier. We have a friendly agent in-field; Agent Griggs is cooped up at a listening station in the Northeastern QZ. The targets are well-equipped and likely the best of their force- we think they're headed towards him. Get there fast.
debriefing: So, our guy got taken alive. They must have been in a hurry- I'm surprised they were sloppy enough to leave this drive intact.

name: Federal Reserve Raid

variants.desc: Clear the lobby and eliminate the Kismet commander.
Clear hostiles and reach the elevator to the vault.
Find a way past the gate.
Find a way past the gate.
Record evidence and find where Kismet breached the vault.
Wait %s seconds for the elevator to close.

briefing: AAAAAA

name: Hammer Down

variants.desc: Find where the explosives are stashed.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: A criminal group, primarily ex-military and PDNY, is gaining prominence in the QZ. Word is they call themselves the ‘Sheepdogs’...They've attacked both UNIDB personnel and independent mercenaries… To make matters worse, they now possess stolen explosives from a lost transport during CRYO containment. We don’t know what they’re planning but it can’t be good. Your mission is to raid the outpost where we think they’re storing the explosives. Clear it out and find clues about their plans.
debriefing: Looks like most of the explosives are already on the move… We can conclude that the Dogs are becoming a more serious threat to Operation CRYO. I’ve got to consult the Board. Keep in touch.

name: Hammer Down, pt. 2

variants.desc: Take the remaining sets of explosives.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: The UNIDB and the US government have lost many good people trying to contain as much of the infected population as possible in the hopes of maybe curing them one day. Our intel suggests the Sheepdogs are planning to demolish the subway tunnels in the QZ to kill the infected en-masse. It goes without saying that if there’s any chance of finding a cure for this thing, these men plan to mass murder millions of human lives that could still be saved. They’ve got a fortified camp in an underground parking lot. Good place to store explosives, if you ask me. Hit their base and recover the explosives.
debriefing: The mission was a clear success. Not only did you secure over half of the missing explosives, but you took a big chunk out of the Sheepdogs’ fighting force. Good work, operator.

name: Hammer Down, pt. 3

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: While the last raid on the Sheepdogs was successful… We’re still missing some explosives, and now, the dogs are biting back. I don’t have solid intel leading to where they’re stashing the goods… So, my thinking is we’ll poke the bear, and try to keep them busy so they can’t pursue the bombing plan. Kill fifteen Sheepdogs, that’ll put a good dent in their capabilities. There’s a lot of them in the Seaport area.
debriefing: The Sheepdogs are hurt bad, we’ve seen them abandon a few of their outposts already. They’re regrouping now, we’ll see if they screw up.

name: Hammer Down, pt. 4

variants.desc: Find the exposed electrical equipment under the Sheepdogs' outpost.
Locate the lower section of the Sheepdogs' fortified outpost.
Fight into the lower section of the Sheepdogs' fortified outpost.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: We had a hard time tracking down the explosives while the Sheepdogs were regrouping… Most of those guys were already criminals long before the QZ was ever a place. However, BER thinks the explosives are on the move right now. The Sheepdogs have an HQ set up at this abandoned construction site, and they’re bringing the cases there. I can’t approve an all-out raid on their HQ yet- they’ve got more firepower than we’d be smart to fight head on. But I’ve got a plan, we just need to cut the power to the building once the payload arrives, keep them from using the elevators. Get moving, we’ve got limited time.
debriefing: Good work, this is the last of the explosives they stole. I’m working on securing resources and approvals to raid their HQ properly, but it’ll take some time.

name: Hammer Down, pt. 5

variants.desc: Locate the National Guards' first evacuation site.
Locate the National Guards' second evacuation site.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: The difference between us and the Sheepdogs is accountability. We need approval from the Board, Platinum Five’s committee, and the American courts to directly target the Sheepdogs’ main base. To secure this approval, we must build a strong case against them, prove that they’re all bad apples. We’ve got decent evidence already but I think the cherry on top will be documenting the conditions the Sheepdogs’ ex National Guard membership left their posts in. They abandoned their posts, which were meant to assist with evacuation measures. We need to clearly illustrate the extent of the damage caused by their dereliction of duty.
debriefing: It’s even worse than I thought. They aren’t just deserters, they’re outright massacrists. With this information, it won’t be hard to convince the public and our leaders to act. Good work.

name: I Hate Goodbyes

variants.desc: Retrieve the teddy bear for Weiss.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Since you raided KISMET, their CEO has started doing the rounds at UNIDB social events. He was spotted at a gala talking to prominent Board investors. Two days ago, ‘testified’ in front of the whole Board about the raid. Turns out, he happened to know the details of our operations here in the QZ. It seems like information that could only be acquired from the John Doe data breach, if you ask me. They’re not asking me though… In fact, they’re shuttering the cure research aspect of CRYO. There’s talks about forgoing the goals of preservation and containment as well. Maybe you can imagine, but I’ve been beside myself for days. I’m writing to you now, Operator, to thank you personally for everything you did for myself, Mercury-2, and the people under New York… I’m sorry those risks were in vain. If I can ask one last thing of you, I scrounged some of the last funds I had to make this happen. My sister and her son were living in the area before the disaster. If a cure isn’t… on the table anymore, I’d like something to remember my nephew by. I’m sending you the address to their apartment. I'd like you to find my nephew’s teddy bear. It’d mean a lot.
debriefing: Thank you again for everything. Not many good people left, these days. As for me, it’s time to quit the UNIDB. Farewell, Operator.

briefing: A request has come in from a collective of insurance companies; They want a ‘neutral’ third-party to take pictures and give a report on damages to some businesses in the QZ. Personally, I don’t think this kind of task is worth our time. However, our organization depends on the good-will of our benefactors, and I’m sure that these insurance groups have direct connections to our corporate support base. Chores for the nobility, I guess.
debriefing: Good work. Forwarding the photos now.

name: Introductions
briefing: There're several other folks on the ship who could use an extra pair of hands. While only Mercury-2 and Platinum-5 leadership have the authority to give you direct orders, that doesn’t stop anyone else on board or elsewhere from putting in requests. Just remember, we aren’t mercenaries. Shuttle rides aren’t cheap, so don’t waste your time or our resources if it isn’t for the good of our mission. With that being said, go ahead and meet the others.

name: Just Keeping the Lights On

variants.desc: Reach the building at Stone x Whitehall.
Find the distribution substation under Stone x Whitehall.
Find the distribution substation under Stone x Whitehall.
Eliminate the Sheepdogs occupying the substation.
Reach the transmission substation near the Brooklyn Bridge.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: You’ve probably noticed that the infected are photophobic. While they’re more numerous on the surface at night, the street lighting grid keeps the millions of infected in the subway tunnels from surfacing. Consequently, if the grid fails, it’ll be catastrophic. The most critical lynchpins of the grid are a transmission station near the Brooklyn Bridge that brings power in from across the water, and an underground distribution center on the opposite side of the QZ. They’re still functional, but we’ve been noticing some concerning fluctuations. We need you to go in, take photos of all the equipment you can see, and recover one of the log storage servers at the distribution center.
debriefing: So, the Sheepdogs found the underground substation… sub-optimal. I’ll have to talk with Bergher about what this implies for the strategic situation. As for the repairs, I’ll have my people take a look at the data you’ve gained and let you know the next steps.

name: Keeping the Lights On, pt. 2

variants.desc: Reach the transmission substation near the Brooklyn Bridge.
Return to the UNS New York.
Reach the transmission substation near the Brooklyn Bridge.
Return to the UNS New York.
Reach the transmission substation near the Brooklyn Bridge.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Good news; the current problem with the above-ground transformer station is simple. Electrical transformers of any size generate heat due to multiple kinds of energy losses- Sorry, that’s besides the point. You saw the large heatsinks on the transformers, right? Well, in the photos we see a couple of broken cooling fans on those heatsinks. We asked the energy company, and they provided us with the last known position of their technician-on-call when the disaster struck. Go find the fans in the technicians’ truck, and replace them. The replacement should be pretty simple, I’m sure you’ve used a screwdriver before.
debriefing: Excellent. We’re already seeing more stability in the grid. The chances of a containment breach are diminished.

name: Kismet HQ Raid

variants.desc: Clear the building of hostiles and reach the penthouse.
Kill the VIPs and their guards.

briefing: AAAAAA

name: Laboratory Space
briefing: Good to meet you, I’m Dr. Weiss, lead researcher for Mercury 2 aboard the UNS New York. I’ll be calling on you later for work, I always need an extra pair of hands in the field. However, I’m reaching out now because I heard you had a large base of operations out near the Seychelles. Space here on the UNS New York is a commodity and Mercury 2’s research capabilities are somewhat hampered by our laboratories being within the jurisdictions of different countries. Nobody wants to let us bring samples from the Quarantine Zone to our labs in their countries. We need a laboratory somewhere outside of normal jurisdictions with lots of resources and security so we can study the virus more in-depth. We’ll pay good money for the privilege if you can build, staff and supply a laboratory for Mercury 2 at your HQ.

name: Laboratory Space pt. 2
briefing: Now that the laboratory is set up, the team there is ready to start processing samples. You’ll have to collect them in the field, but once you do, we’ll pay you for every hour of research we get out of them. You should be able to find valuable samples in the zombies’ ‘nests’, look for anything small enough to pick up that looks organic and well, weird. Collect a sample and research it and I’ll pay double for your first time.

name: Late Premiere

variants.desc: Find a way to get into the projector room.

briefing: Before things went to hell, I was working as a sous-chef at a restaurant in the financial district, right near the New Ground Zero. It was a sweet gig, pay was good and the head chef there was one of the best in the city. Always wearing his red baseball cap, the guy had a real mean streak, threatening to kill us all the time for small mistakes. Twisted sense of humor, I guess. Whatever. Great cook. He had a special recipe for a beef stew. Wasn’t on the menu, but he served it to me one time and it was divine. I asked for the recipe after and he almost fired me. Got glares for a week after that. That being said, I’ve been craving it for weeks. Never had anything quite like it. I think he had his recipes written down in a notebook somewhere, if we’re lucky, it might still be somewhere at the restaurant.

name: Medical Assistant

variants.desc: Find medical scissors, pincers, tweezers and a scalpel.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Hi there! I'm Nurse Najjar. The Chief Medical Officer is usually ever so busy, so I'll be the one helping you on behalf of the medical team here on the UNS New York. We, uh, we often struggle to sterilize our equipment as quickly as we need to for patient care. If you could, perhaps, bring back a few medical tools for us, it would be a huge favor to everyone on the ship. We'd be grateful.
debriefing: Thank you kindly, this will help us take care of patients faster! You’ll be hearing from me again.

name: Medical Assistant, pt. 2

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Hey! We really appreciate the help you gave us earlier with finding those tools. I’ve got another favor to ask, a bit harder this time, but we need it. We’re running out of IV fluids in Medical… Not ideal. Please head out and find us 2 unused IV bags, that’ll take care of our patients who are waiting.
debriefing: Thank you! This will save lives. Til next time!

name: Missing In Action

variants.desc: Look for Sergeant Pierrat at his last known location.
Look for Sergeant Pierrat inside the building.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: About half a year ago, the ‘successes’ of Platinum’s operation to retake that island from terrorists were plastered all over the news. The few survivors from that missile silo, lucky enough to be wearing high-end CBRN equipment, were later assigned to CRYO. One of those maniacs, a Sergeant Pierrat, got sent into the QZ two days ago, and went dark twelve hours ago. Obviously, we need to find him. He’s a tough, ‘survive anything’ type, so I’m betting he’s still kicking. Operations gave us some vague tracking data, so get going.
debriefing: Huh. I'm not sure what he was up to, keeping an eye on the New Ground Zero nest, maybe? Not a good sign that he left the CSEL behind. Unfortunately, without that, I'm not sure where to go next. Pierrat is a personal friend of mine, brave and loyal to a fault towards his country and our organization. If someone got to him while he was in the field, I know he won't say anything. Hopefully he hasn't been captured

name: Needle in a Haystack

variants.desc: Find the Kismet Technical Director's cell phone.

tasks.tagline: The phone is likely under a bodybag near the inside or near the entrance to the Metro Hospital.

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: The hard drive didn't have what we were looking for, just two terabytes of footage from the QZ... 5 months ago. Something's fishy, if you ask me. We've already had two Beryllium agents turn up working against us... This could be a third rat, defecting to the enemy in the guise of a kidnapping. It's time we hit their office and find out for ourselves. Small problem; they've got anti-air capability and you'd be dead before we could get you onto the roof. However, their Technical Director was a confirmed victim in the first days of the disaster, one of the last names logged at Site B. I'm sending you the details of the model of his phone, it's probably on his body, somewhere in the hospital. I'll give you hazard pay this time.
debriefing: This is what we were looking for. Tech says they'll be able to open the elevator remotely. Time for the big show. Good luck.

name: No Role Models

variants.desc: Find where the traitors are holed up.
Use the CSEL to call for extraction and return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Over the months since CRYO began, Platinum soldiers have become increasingly disgruntled. I get it, conditions are rough, rations tight. We're not the world's darlings anymore, but our job is to grit our teeth and bear it. Desertion isn’t an answer. Four Platinum guys killed the researchers they were assigned to protect and abandoned their post. Whatever broke them, explanations are over. Their brutality is inexcusable. Find them, eliminate them. We make examples of traitors.
debriefing: It’s grim work but it had to happen. Well done. I don’t like using the stick against my own men- I’ll have Chef Agbayani get in contact with you about how to maybe give our guys a carrot.

name: Population Control

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Eliminating the infected isn’t one of our operational objectives- actually, quite the opposite. Our end objective is to ideally cure the hundreds of thousands to millions of infected waiting in the tunnels under the city… and contain them in the meantime. However, it’s very hard to accomplish that objective when there’s tens of thousands of infected above the surface. For this reason, all infected on the surface are cleared for elimination, if necessary. With that being said… Infected soldiers are far more dangerous than infected civilians. Infected individuals retain their strength and speed, and, well, soldiers tend to have more of that. We need you to cull some of the infected soldiers in the QZ, to make containment work and research safer in the long run. These infected tend to be found in the higher-risk areas of the QZ.
debriefing: Thank you, that couldn’t have been easy. Thank these soldiers for their sacrifice. We’ve got a better chance of saving everyone else now.

name: Predictive Algorithms

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Hello, Operator. I've been hearing lots about you. You'll be glad to know: Investigations into some of the hostiles from the Federal Reserve and Site B basement reveal they are the 'personal security detail' for KISMET, a publicly traded multinational datatech corporation. Surprisingly, every UNIDB division has ties to them; apparently, Platinum Five even trades 'anonymized' mission data for networking support from the company. We are now facing a paramilitary force with superior funding and intelligence. Recently, they have been patrolling streets and eliminating the undead without a clear motive. I need you to engage a few of them so we can gauge their response.
debriefing: Excellent. We're watching their reaction now.

name: Predictive Algorithms
briefing: I just received a phone call from one of my sources, and was told there’s been a kill order put out on me. Please get here quickly. That ledger had some direct lines… the Manhattan Star receives funding from the owner of Kismet, and I think they want to keep me from revealing that to the public. They likely want me to panic, bail and die in the Q.Z. instead of staying here and writing. I’ll wait for your arrival at the hideout. I’m armed, announce yourself before you enter.
debriefing: Excellent, I'm starting to put a story together already. I'll be in touch.

name: Quid Pro Quo
briefing: I’m a big fan of reciprocity. I’ve got a lot of connections and I can get you more gifts and plenty of work for good money headed your way if you’re willing to do me a favor. I’m sort of in-between living situations right now- despite my charm, there’s a few folks in the US government and even the UNJTF who don’t like me too much. The world is built against entrepreneurs, you know? It’s real cold here in the QZ and I’m getting a bit sick of this lifestyle. If you could set me up with some accommodations on your island, nothing fancy, I’ll be your guy for high-paying work. I make a mean omelette, too.

name: Research Fellow

variants.desc: Locate the apartment building on Old Slip x Water.
Search the burned apartment for clues.
Return to the UNS New York.

tasks.tagline: Found locked safe in the apartment

briefing: “An old friend and peer of mine, Dr. Beth Maison, was running the research department at Metro Hospital when the disaster hit. We met again for the first time in years when I arrived at the hospital following the first cases arriving there... She wasn’t happy that I took over her project, but she mentioned that one of her fellows was working on a dissertation regarding engineered viruses. We sent that fellow home to collect his research, but he didn’t return before we had to evacuate. Supposedly, the research was primarily focused on engineering virophages- viruses that eat other viruses. You can probably guess why that’s important to us. I fear the worst happened to this fellow, but, if we’re lucky, his drafts and research material might still be at his home. Go to his apartment and collect any documents you can.”
debriefing: Oh dear. It looks like my suspicions were correct that his research is important, clearly enough for someone to commit arson. I hope he wasn’t in the apartment when it burned. The safe surviving is good news, though, a fireproof safe like that is exactly where I’d store my master drafts. I’ll try to get in contact with Dr. Maison and see if she might know where the key for the safe could be found.

name: Research Fellow, pt. 2

variants.desc: Find a key into the records room.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Beth was distraught to hear about what we found. She doesn’t know where to find the key, but we might be able to find clues if we can track down the hospitals’ personnel review files. Unfortunately that means you’ve got to head into the Metro Hospital- she says the hospital’s administration ran out of the top floors of the main tower- wing A. The files will probably be in a records room near the HR offices- Room 15A3.

name: Research Fellow, pt. 3

variants.desc: Search the Gym, Basketball Court, and Hot Mug Cafe for the yellow duffel bag.

tasks.tagline: Panda's Gym on Broad x Old Slip
Hot Mug Cafe on South Street

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.
Search the Gym, Basketball Court, and Hot Mug Cafe for the yellow duffel bag.

Hot Mug Cafe on South Street

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.
Search the Gym, Basketball Court, and Hot Mug Cafe for the yellow duffel bag.

tasks.tagline: Panda's Gym on Broad x Old Slip
Hot Mug Cafe on South Street

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: So, we looked through the information you found at the hospital. Our man was big into morning exercise. His routine involved him going to Panda Gym every morning, and getting a latte at a little cafe in Seaport. Seems like he’d also stop by a basketball court on Broadway from time to time. Beth managed to remember that he usually kept a yellow duffel bag with him with a change of clothes, so I’m hoping he might’ve left it somewhere along that route when he got called to the hospital for the emergency. Go check out those spots, and if you can find a key, grab the documents from the safe at his apartment and return here. If this research is as valuable as it seems, it could give my research team something good to go on to find a cure.
debriefing: You found the documents? Great! Judging by the men who tried to get the jump on you, I’d guess they’ve been tracking your movements since you first got to the burned apartment. Looks like they really wanted this paper. That means we’re on the right track for sure. Thank you, Operator, you’ve done us all a great service

name: Safety Inspection

variants.desc: Photograph the M.Q.I.U from all sides.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Before the Manhattan disaster, we developed Mobile Quarantine units to contain aerosolized virus 'orphan sources.' Learning from Ronograd and, long before that, Chernobyl, this technology saved lives; The first and only M.Q was deployed to Ground Zero Two within a day. We’ve been detecting an increasing concentration of airborne virus in the area, so my assumption is that the M.Q has failed. Head there with the appropriate PPE and photograph the M.Q from all sides.
debriefing: The M.Q.I.U. seems to be holding out in these pictures, I can’t see any visible leaks, at least. I’ve got another hypothesis as to the cause of the dangerous air, I’ll start looking into it. I’m also giving you a voucher for a higher-quality gasmask filter.

name: Secret Recipe

variants.desc: Locate the restaurant at 64 S William St.
Kill the bandits and their leader.
Use your CSEL device to call for an extraction.

briefing: Before things went to hell, I was working as a sous-chef at a restaurant in the financial district, right near the New Ground Zero. It was a sweet gig, pay was good and the head chef there was one of the best in the city. Always wearing his red baseball cap, the guy had a real mean streak, threatening to kill us all the time for small mistakes. Twisted sense of humor, I guess. Whatever. Great cook. He had a special recipe for a beef stew. Wasn’t on the menu, but he served it to me one time and it was divine. I asked for the recipe after and he almost fired me. Got glares for a week after that. That being said, I’ve been craving it for weeks. Never had anything quite like it. I think he had his recipes written down in a notebook somewhere, if we’re lucky, it might still be somewhere at the restaurant.
debriefing: You ran into the chef? He tried to kill you?? And the recipe? You found it where? Under what? Oh my god. Ohhhhhh my god… Listen, thanks for doing that, but I gotta catch you later. I need to be alone for a while. I think I’m gonna be sick.

name: Shallow End

variants.desc: Enter the Southern Manhattan Quarantine Zone by catching a ride on the 'shuttle'
Find fresh canned food, medicine, and potable water.
Use the CSEL to call for extraction and return to the UNS New York.

briefing: You're new around here. Good to meet you, I'm Lieutenant Commander Bergher, second in command for Operation CRYO. You’re here aboard the UNS New York, so, you work for me now. Listen, you look tough, but I've lost tougher looking operators in the Quarantine Zone. If you aren't just going to freeload, you're going to have to prove you can take care of yourself and contribute to the ship. Surviving in the QZ will require you to exploit whatever resources are available. I figure you should prove that you can scavenge and avoid the hordes, so take the shuttle into the QZ and bring back a haul of medicine, canned food and potable water. If you come back alive, I'll give you some work.
debriefing: Well, you made it back in one piece. Good job getting your hands on these supplies. Rations have been tight since our most recent resupply boat got attacked.

name: Shallow End 2

variants.desc: Locate the bandit camp under the overpass.
Use the CSEL to call for extraction and return to the UNS New York.
Locate the bandit camp in the apartment building.
Use the CSEL to call for extraction and return to the UNS New York.
Locate the bandit camp in the alley.
Use the CSEL to call for extraction and return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Remember that supply boat I mentioned? The fools who attacked it didn't even get in the water to retrieve the cargo, just wasted the men on board from the shore. Such a pointless crime. We managed to ID the three of them, we think they’re living in a camp right across the water in Seaport. If you want me to start giving you real work, go eliminate all three of them so they can’t harm our people again. Careful though, they might have friends.
debriefing: Those guys were nasty, the QZ is a little safer with them gone. Also, it seems like you can handle yourself. I think it’s about time I clear you to work with the other folks on board.

name: Sheepdog Stronghold Raid

variants.desc: Reach the Sheepdogs HQ at the construction site.
Wait %s seconds for the elevator to start.
Wait %s seconds for the elevator to start.
Wait %s seconds for the elevator to start.
Clear the roof of remaining hostiles.

briefing: AAAAA

name: Spreading the Word

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: The photo you took of the collapsed crane was the cover of today's edition of the Cooperative Publication. Folks on social media have been quick to choose sides over this event- those who follow the Star think the UNIDB was the aggressor. My people are working on combatting misinformation in the outside world, but I need you to combat it from within the QZ. There's still survivors, researchers and independent actors in the QZ who need to know what's going on and have a real source to trust. The last thing you'd want is more folks inside the QZ being radicalized against the UNIDB and joining the Sheepdogs. I need you to head around and place five editions of today's edition over the Manhattan Star's postings.

name: The Deep End

variants.desc: Locate the New Ground Zero field laboratory.
Find the lab key in the parking garage.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: A scientist by the name of Lakewell was in charge of the research team sent to study and assist with the aftermath at New Ground Zero. Before we lost contact, he reported that they had some samples of the powder deployed in the explosion of the attack- the weaponized form of the virus. We got traces from the Ronograd attack but it's possible these samples are in a higher quantity. We'd like you to investigate the fate of Lakewell and his team but the priority of this assignment is to track down those samples.
debriefing: So, they got out in time? Lakewell probably figured it would end up like Rono and took off early. Since the samples weren't there, Site C is the next stop.

name: The Deep End, pt. 2

variants.desc: Find where Lakewell kept the samples.
Retrieve the samples and data about Lakewell's whereabouts.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Lakewell and his team retreated to Site C before New Ground Zero, or Site A, overran. He likely assumed Metro Hospital would meet a similar fate, but Site C was only just being set up at the time. If he and his team made it there, it's likely the samples went with them. The camp was set up in the water treatment plant underneath the highway overpass.
debriefing: These are the samples we're looking for. That was dangerous cargo from a dangerous place. We owe a lot to your courage, operator. As for Lakewell, I hope he made it out of there in time.

name: The Deep End, pt. 3

variants.desc: Locate the building on William and Fulton.
Samples lost. Kill the ambushers and escape the area.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Operator, I apologize for the deception. Lakewell has been alive; we maintained a cover for security. Your last mission all but confirmed that a ‘John Doe’ has been sabotaging us by accessing your logs and giving you unauthorized orders. We suspected you might be involved, but Lakewell's man vouched for you, given you fought alongside him. Bergher has since cut off John Doe's access and begun an official investigation. Immediately afterward, tracked samples went missing from my lab and off the ship. The mole is moving. I'm sending you the location. To clear your name, retrieve the samples and, if possible, identify and terminate John Doe.
debriefing: Once again, John Doe was a step ahead. The sample container was empty. Glad you survived, Operator.

name: Trail to a Cure

variants.desc: Reach the Metro Hospital in Site B.
Find the refrigerator containing the samples.
Climb to room 11A3 and retrieve the key to the chemical refrigerator.
Retrieve the key to the chemical refrigerator.
Return to the chemical refrigerator in Lab 3
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: A while back I had you recover that dissertation regarding virophages. Since then I’ve finally managed to read through enough of the thing to see the value in it- I hope the man who wrote it survived, he might be up for a nobel prize one day. Anyway, I’m calling on you again because the dissertation details some experiments he was running at the hospital. There’s some samples in one of the laboratories that I want to get my hands on, I think we’ve got a pretty good lead here. Of course, even with that done, a cure is still a long way off, but this is the first time it’s seemed a genuine possibility to me.
debriefing: I’m not sure what that massive group of mercenaries could’ve been doing there… I had no idea what I was sending you into. We’re lucky you survived.

name: Tutorial

variants.desc: Find Commander Bergher aboard the UNS New York.
Return to the assignments tablet to complete your initiation.

briefing: You're new around here. Good to meet you, I'm Lieutenant Commander Bergher, second in command for Operation CRYO. You’re here aboard the UNS New York, so, you work for me now. You and the other new arrivals are a sight for sore eyes, we need all the help we can get. Let's quickly get you acquainted with our assignment software. Accept this task and come meet me in the command room.

name: Unknown Caller

variants.desc: Find the dead drop left by the anonymous sender.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: You don’t know me, but I know you. I figure we’ll have a run in some time or another, so either you stay out of my way, or instead, we figure out something good for us both… On the hush hush. You’ve already made some moves and I think we’d be simpatico, yeah? How about you come pick up this small gift from me, just to let you get familiarised with the QZ. Here’s the spot.
debriefing: I had a feeling you’d run into some trouble… I bet you’re glad I showed up to help. I hope that proves what a help I could be to you… You can call me Fixer, I’ll be in touch on how you can maybe return the favor. Enjoy the gift.

name: Up For Some Gaming?

variants.desc: Find a hard copy of the project.
Return to the UNS New York.
Find a hard copy of the project in the Activity-Full office.
Return to the UNS New York.
Find a hard copy of the project.
Return to the UNS New York.
Find a hard copy of the project.
Return to the UNS New York.
Find a hard copy of the project.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Knew these people back in the day- total dorks, the lot of them. They’re software developers or graphic designers or something. They had a project going at their office in town when the disaster struck- I caught wind that they’ve been poking around... looking for mercenaries to recover it. Might be able to get some cash for it if you can find a hard copy before their mercs do. Chop chop.
debriefing: Nice. I’ll get in touch with my old friends- see if maybe we can cut a deal. If not, I might threaten to leak their project… they used to hate that, aha.

name: Wetwork

variants.desc: Find the Subway station on the corner of Stone and Broadway.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: I've got a job from someone new... won't give me a name or a clear ID, but they've got a lot of capital so I don't think we need to look a gift horse in the mouth. They're looking for you specifically- apparently you've been making waves and people are paying attention. Anyway, the client wants photos from the subway at Stone and Broadway. Apparently, there's a big nest in the tunnels and they want photos of the entrances. They say there's more work ahead if you can get those photos to them pronto. Good luck!
debriefing: Gnarly stuff, those nests. Hopefully I can get out of the QZ soon, kinda feels like I'm sitting on a ticking time bomb now. I'll have the client reach out to you directly for the next jobs.

name: Wetwork, pt. 2

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: Hey there, Operator. Forgive me for the anonymity, but I've got reason to believe your outfit isn't as tight a ship as you think. I honestly didn't expect you to survive that subway job, your pal Fixer has let me down before. Glad you did though, it sounds like I was right in thinking you'd be a capable pair of hands. The next job I need from you is a bit trickier- I'm trying to put something together at the hospital, and I need some prepwork done. There's a sewer manhole at the intersection of Water and Dover, you'll need to climb down there. There's 3 big sewer doors that I need you to close. It'll probably be pretty toxic down there, so be careful. Get that done and I'll brief you on the big job.

name: Wetwork, pt. 3

variants.desc: Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: So, as promised: I got word that the first individuals showing signs of infection at Site B were carted away by unknowns and taken down into the basement isolation unit. The area is locked up tight and has that huge 'nest' of infected around it, so we need to line up a pretty clean plan to get in and back out without you getting overrun. I'll have one of my contacts joining you at the hospital when we're ready but I need you to run some prepwork in the meantime. There's a small sewer connection to the Hospital's sublevel, that'll be your exit route after the big job, we need to make sure it's locked off so you don't get swarmed.

name: Wetwork, pt. 4

variants.desc: Locate the subway station at Pine x Water.
Return to the UNS New York.

briefing: When the containment effort first started in New York, they needed to bait the hordes into the right places using special devices. They make a high-pitched sound that makes the zombies real jumpy, even the hibernating ones. They'd be a perfect distraction for us to make a move without getting a horde on us. There's a metro station under Site B where I'm sure the Marines left one of the devices. Find it and drop it off in the courtyard alley near the corner of Broad X Pine. I'll leave you a key to unlock the gate.

name: Wetwork, pt. 5

variants.desc: Reach the elevator in room 2A31 of the hospital.
Get to the basement of the Hospital and meet Lakewell's contact.
Get to the basement of the Hospital and meet Lakewell's contact.

briefing: So, time for the big job. It's likely that the infected were being studied down in the hospital basement before things got too out of hand. We don't know what organization was active in the basement, and I want you to find out. Meet my contact in Wing C of the hospital, he'll have set up the distractions by the time you get there. You'll have limited time once you're in the basement to find anything of importance - samples, ideally, but notes, videos, what have you as well. Find out who was running those experiments down there.

name: Whistleblower

variants.desc: Get to the XXX Broad office building.
Find the USB stick on one of the desks.

briefing: TThose guys who you took out at the meetup with (Defector Name), well it turns out they were contractors for a local private security firm. We found an ex-employee through some private communication channels who might have some information that can connect the firm to our enemies. I've got a hunch that he's legit, but there's a hangup. He wants a USB stick, he won't tell me why it's so important but won't talk without it. He says it can be found in the fourth floor offices at XXX Broad. There's some criminals posted up there who scared him off when he tried to get it himself. The USB stick should be on one of the desks.
